 Joe Beninati and Craig Laughlin are getting a rare night off as the Washington Capitals will be playing on national television tonight — well, sorta.
 Tonight’s Capitals game against the Tampa Bay Lightning will be streamed exclusively nationwide on ESPN+, Disney+, and Hulu, with puck drop scheduled for 7:30 pm. 
 According to ESPN PR , Bob Wischusen and Ray Ferraro will be on the call, joined by NHL rules analyst Dave Jackson. ESPN’s studio coverage will feature Steve Levy, Mark Messier, and Emily Kaplan. The game will mark the third stop of Alex Ovechkin’s farewell tour.
 Caps-Lightning will be the first of 9 exclusive Capitals’ games to be aired on ESPN this season, per Andrea DiCristoforo .
